title: 第9章 临门一脚第10章 打卡名场面
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
[气运随机掠夺+400！]
[目标吴念儿，气运值损失400！]
[您目前的气运值为3099，已晋升为蓝级气运，请再接再厉]
接连数道提示音自方玉凝耳边响起。
下一刻，她只觉得浑身暖洋洋的。
而反观对面的吴念儿，却像是霜打了的茄子一般。
一双漂亮的眸子看向这边，心中隐约带着几分警惕。
突然间，吴念儿感觉自己身体不适。
探索半天都未查到根本的她，只能将这一切，都归结在与这个林尘八字犯冲。
“吴爷爷，可以了。”
用仅有两人能够听到的声音，吴念儿轻声说着。
让吴文峰暗中对林尘释放气息，自然是她所授意的。
这婚约当年定下之时，她便有所不满。
只是觉着林尘颇有少年天才的名头，这才容忍一二。
现在对方成了废人，自己又马上要拜入青阳剑宗。
这么些年她一直在努力，对方不曾进步也就罢了，反而还有所倒退！
如今，正是摆脱对方的最佳时机。
她心中一番梳理后，手中纳戒闪过一丝毫光，手掌大小的玉盒凭空而现。
盒盖打开，一阵浓郁的药香，顿时在四周弥漫开来。
“林川叔父，听闻林尘师兄早年身有暗疾，修为跌至凝血三层，所以我特意准备了四品固元丹，专治内伤暗疾，重塑根基。”

“此丹足可助林尘师兄，早日突破凝血第四层瓶颈。”
固元丹？
许多族人听后，都不禁面露艳羡之色。
林家祖宗以炼药建立根基，后世子孙即便没有了炼药天赋。
但大多对各类丹药以及药效，都十分了解。
平日里，家族子弟常用丹药皆是一、二品。
三品丹药，都几乎是难得一见。
更别提如今出现在眼前的四品丹药。
不仅是普通族人，就连几位族老，都对这丹药眼馋的紧。
只想着赶紧让林尘答应下来，然后好以家族的名义将丹药讨要到手。
毕竟，林尘修炼真气在体内无法汇聚成型，废人一个。
将这等丹药交在他手上，也是暴殄天物！
content_en:
[Luck random plunder +400! ]
[Target Wu Nian'er, lost 400 luck points! ]
[Your current luck value is 3099 and you have been promoted to blue level luck. Please keep up your efforts]
Several prompt tones rang in Fang Yuning's ears.
The next moment, she felt warm all over.
On the other hand, Wu Nian'er on the opposite side looked like an eggplant beaten by frost.
A pair of beautiful eyes looked here, with a hint of vigilance in his heart.
Suddenly, Wu Nian'er felt unwell.
After searching for a long time but unable to find out the root cause, she could only attribute all of this to her conflict with Lin Chen.
"Grandpa Wu, it's okay."
Wu Nian'er spoke softly in a voice that only two people could hear.
It was naturally her instruction to let Wu Wenfeng secretly release his aura to Lin Chen.
When the engagement was made, she was dissatisfied.
He just felt that Lin Chen had a reputation as a young genius, so he tolerated it.
Now that the other party has become a useless person, he is about to join the Qingyang Sword Sect.
She has been working hard for so many years, but it's just that the other party has not made progress, but has regressed!
Now is the best time to get rid of each other.
After combing through her mind, the ring in her hand flashed with light, and a palm-sized jade box appeared out of thin air.
When the lid of the box was opened, a strong medicinal fragrance suddenly spread all around.
"Uncle Lin Chuan, I heard that Senior Brother Lin Chen suffered from hidden diseases in his early years, and his cultivation dropped to the third level of blood coagulation, so I specially prepared a fourth-grade Gu Yuan Dan, which is specially designed to treat internal injuries and hidden diseases and rebuild the foundation."
"This elixir can help Senior Brother Lin Chen break through the fourth level of blood coagulation bottleneck as soon as possible."
Guyuan Dan?
After hearing this, many tribesmen couldn't help but look envious.
The ancestors of the Lin family established their foundation by refining medicine, even if their descendants no longer have the talent for refining medicine.
But most of them are very familiar with various types of elixirs and their effects.
On weekdays, the commonly used elixirs used by the family's children are first and second grade.
Third-grade elixirs are almost rare.
Not to mention the fourth-grade elixir that now appears in front of you.
Not only the ordinary clan members, but also several clan elders were eager for this elixir.
He just wanted to get Lin Chen to agree quickly so that he could get the elixir in the name of his family.
After all, Lin Chen's cultivation energy could not be gathered and formed in his body, and he was a useless person.
Putting this kind of elixir in his hands would be a waste of natural resources!
